events.title: Former 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager Keith Burkinshaw is sacked by Sporting Lisbon of Portugal .
Tommy Docherty is sacked after just over four months in charge of GM Vauxhall Conference side Altrincham.
A UEFA referendum decides that all English clubs will be banned from European competition for a fourth successive season. 더비 카운티 sign midfielder Ted McMinn from Seville of Spain for £300,000.
18 of the 25 리버풀 fans charged with manslaughter in connection with the Heysel disaster return home after being cleared of the charges.
리버풀 sell striker Paul Walsh to 토트넘 홋스퍼 for £500,000.

슈루즈버리 타운 striker Jim Melrose , on loan from 리즈 유나이티드, suffers a broken cheekbone in a clash with 스윈던 타운 midfielder Chris Kamara at the end of Shrewsbury's 2–1 win over Swindon in the Second Division at Gay Meadow . In a heavyweight clash in the FA Cup fifth round, 아스널 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 2–1 at Highbury .
리버풀 avenge their League Cup defeat earlier in the season by beating 에버턴 1–0 in the FA Cup fifth round at Goodison Park .
토트넘 홋스퍼 sign goalkeeper Bobby Mimms from 에버턴 for £325,000. 스윈던 타운 fine midfielder Chris Kamara £1,000 and ban him from playing for a month following the incident with Jim Melrose.
루턴 타운 reach the League Cup final with a 3–1 aggregate win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.

February draws to a close with 리버풀 still top of the league having stretched their unbeaten start to the season to 27 games, and with a 14-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 with two games in hand. The Second Division promotion race sees 애스턴 빌라 and 블랙번 로버스 level at the top of the table, with 밀월, 미들즈브러 and 브래드퍼드 시티 occupying the play-off places.
